inc-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert — Dedicated pool 'eu-dedicated-01' experiencing sustained p99 latency > 3s and streaming stalls. Autoscaler showed scale intent but warmup delays led to queue amplification. Paging #incidents and current oncall. Snapshot: p95=420ms (norm ~120ms), p99=3.2s, queue_depth=470, warmup_latency=5-7s.

Maya G.: seeing a steady increase in queued requests since ~21:02 UTC. Tail tokens spike correlates with large-batch requests from a handful of customer routes. Streaming stalls manifest as truncated SSE frames.

Samira K.: likely warmup amplification — GPUs are spinning up but model KV/caches not ready, so first requests block and backlog grows. Autoscaler cooldown is 90s which makes things worse for sudden bursts. Immediate mitigation: 1) manual scale up pool, 2) route high-concurrency customers to fallback model variant (quantized smaller) for 10m, 3) enable emergency prefix cache warmup job.

AJ: copying mitigation steps, running manual scale now.
AJ: ```
# manual scale up pool
redwoodctl pool resize --pool eu-dedicated-01 --replicas 6
# result
resizing: eu-dedicated-01  -> replicas: 4 -> 6
```

OpsBot: metric update — after manual scale command: replicas=6, start-up events observed. p95 dropped slightly to 280ms but p99 still ~1.8s; queue depth down to 220. Streaming stalls still intermittently reported.

Carla (oncall): customer impact — 3 paying customers (acct: acme-inc, voxai, ledgerly) reported degraded streaming during 21:03–21:10 UTC. We have 12 error hits for streaming timeouts and ~18 reports of partial payloads. CS is preparing proactive notifications.

Maya G.: note — hotspot routes are /chat/stream for acme-inc and /generate for voxai. Their traffic patterns are many parallel short-lived streams which exacerbate warmup.

Samira K.: temp routing rule applied: route customer tags acme-inc,voxai -> model redwood-small-quant for 8 minutes. Also lowered max_batch_size for eu-dedicated-01 to 8 to reduce head-of-line blocking.

AJ: applied routing and batch config. Commands: ```
redwoodctl route update --selector "customer in (acme-inc,voxai)" --model redwood-small-quant --ttl 480
redwoodctl config set --pool eu-dedicated-01 --max_batch_size 8
```

OpsBot: autoscaler anomaly — detected missed scale event at 21:04 UTC due to a race in scale planning when two bursts coincided; rollback of planner patch in staging recommended. Logged as AUTOSCALE-349.

Leo W.: for medium term: increase autoscaler min_replicas for burst-prone pools, reduce scale_cooldown to 30s for dedicated pools, and add proactive warmup (prefill KV cache) when scale intent is issued. Also suggest a hotshot-warmup pipeline that preloads most-requested prompt prefixes.

Carla (oncall): handing incident to Leo for follow-up and postmortem. I'll stay on CS comms for notification drafts. Handoff note: we have mitigations in place (manual replicas, routing to smaller model, reduced batch size).

Leo W.: will run a rolling check of warmup success across new replicas and patch autoscaler config. Can someone drop the command output for pool readiness?

AJ: pool readiness: ```
eu-dedicated-01: replicas=6
replica_status: [ready, ready, warming, ready, ready, warming]
warmup_cache_hits: [12, 14, 2, 11, 9, 3]
```

Maya G.: streaming error logs (truncated): ```
2026-03-14T21:05:12Z stream_conn: client=acme-inc id=xx123 error=timeout frame=partial
2026-03-14T21:06:01Z enqueue: queue_depth=470 delay=430ms route=/chat/stream
```

Samira K.: marking mitigations: manual scale applied, routing fallback active, max_batch_size lowered. Recommend follow-up action items for postmortem: - add warmup prefill on scale event - telemetry to alert on queue amplification (queue_depth surge + sustained warmup_latency) - autoscaler cooldown tuning and planner race fix.

Carla (oncall): customer comms sent (draft) to affected accounts. No SLA credits yet; monitoring for sustained impact.

Leo W.: patching autoscaler planner now (small change to lock plan idempotency). Will run a canary in staging before prod deploy. ETA ~40m.

Maya G.: after routing + scale, p95 ~160-220ms, p99 trending down to ~800ms at 21:22 UTC. Queue depth stabilized ~60. Streaming stall reports dropped to baseline.

Carla (oncall): marking incident status: mitigated. Handoff complete — Leo owning the follow-up actions and postmortem. Closing the page but keeping channel open until postmortem is filed. :white_check_mark:

Leo W.: noted. I'll file AUTOSCALE-349 and include runbook edits for dedicated pools, and propose default min_replicas bump.

Maya G.: thanks all — good run.
__note: This document is a single Slack thread; messages are a continuous string with sender prefixes as required.
